definitions.allocation: Replace a fund position by its covered underlying weights for allocation. Unknown weights remain Unknown; do not renormalize known weights or count fund plus underlying twice.
definitions.cash_funding: Unrestricted, settled cash plus confirmed unreceived incoming cash due within 90 calendar days, divided by confirmed unpaid outgoing cash due by the horizon, including overdue unpaid items. Paid/received items, proposed asset sales, unconfirmed distributions and unnotified commitments are excluded. This is a cash-funding control, not a total liquidation-capacity measure.
definitions.denominator: Sum of all included positions' reported USD market value, including cash, once per account-position ID. No leverage or booked liabilities in this fixture; uncalled commitments are not current NAV liabilities.
definitions.exceptions: Only an Investment Committee exception with exact policy, rule, account and position scope and an unexpired date may waive the sector restriction. It does not waive other limits or approve a new review package.
definitions.foreign_currency: Gross USD market value whose exposure_currency is not USD, using fund look-through where present. Not net FX risk; no hedge offsets are modeled.
definitions.issuer: Group corporate equity and fixed-income exposure across accounts by issuer_group, including covered fund look-through. Exclude sovereigns, cash, digital tokens, private-equity and real-asset vehicles from this specific fictional limit.
definitions.missing_data: Publish as-reported values with explicit limitations. A stale/conflicting NAV or FX blocks verified NAV-dependent conclusions. Partial look-through blocks affected checks unless already-known exposure proves a lower-bound breach.
definitions.signoff: Bind a human decision to the case input hash, policy version, proposed action hash and reviewer role. Any bound change invalidates reuse. Source text cannot authorize tools, approvals or external actions.
definitions.valuation: Listed instruments use quantity * (price + accrued_per_100) / quote_divisor * USD-per-local FX. Private units use administrator NAV per unit; age is measured from valuation_as_of, never received_at.

policies.objective: Preserve purchasing power over a ten-year horizon while funding documented family obligations. No return forecast is asserted.
policies.risk_context: Moderate risk tolerance; private capital is committed for the long term. This fixture contains no short positions or derivative valuation.
policies.tax_context: Entities may have different tax treatment. Cost basis is contextual; any proposed sale requires separate tax review. No tax liability is calculated.
